name: BAD-HEROKU-BOT
description: Heroku controller bot. Controls your Heroku apps using your Heroku API key.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram user ID(s) allowed to control the bot. Separate multiple IDs with a space.

LOGGER_ID.description: Optional. Chat ID (user/group/channel) where the bot sends a message when it starts. Example: -1001234567890

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. GitHub token with write access, only needed for the Push to GitHub button.
